newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish 7.5 bln SKR T-bill auction oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Swedish 7.5 bln SKR T-bill auction oversubscribed.

text.p: An auction of Swedish T-bills worth 7.5 billion crowns was heavily oversubscribed, Sweden's National Debt Office said on Wednesday.
The average accepted rate in an auction of three-month Treasury bills worth 500 million crowns was 4.06 percent.
The office received 16 bids worth 2.42 billion crowns of which it accepted four.
An auction of one year T-bills worth seven billion crowns had an average accepted rate of 4.51 percent.
The debt office said it received 92 bids worth 15.9 billion crowns and accepted 34 bids.
